WITH customer_consumption AS (
  SELECT c.Segment, c.CustomerID, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
  FROM customers c
  JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
  WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND y.Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'
  GROUP BY c.Segment, c.CustomerID
),
min_per_segment AS (
  SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
  FROM customer_consumption
  GROUP BY Segment
),
avg_per_segment AS (
  SELECT m.Segment, SUM(cc.total_consumption) / COUNT(*) AS annual_average
  FROM min_per_segment m
  JOIN customer_consumption cc ON m.Segment = cc.Segment AND m.min_consumption = cc.total_consumption
  GROUP BY m.Segment
)
SELECT 
  (SELECT annual_average FROM avg_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT annual_average FROM avg_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_minus_LAM,
  (SELECT annual_average FROM avg_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT annual_average FROM avg_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_minus_KAM,
  (SELECT annual_average FROM avg_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT annual_average FROM avg_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_minus_SME
